title: Supabase (YC S20) Is Hiring for Multigres
summary: Supabase, a Y Combinator S20 company and open-source Firebase alternative, is recruiting for a role related to 'Multigres' - likely focused on multi-database or PostgreSQL infrastructure development. The job posting appears on their Ashby ATS system.
